events.body:
## Context

README says captures are uploaded to BLT and you can select an area; `background.js` only downloads `screenshot.png` and the area editor isn't loaded by `manifest.json`. It describes a tag-triggered GitHub Action and GitHub Pages setup (the real release is the manual `.forkmesh/blt-extension--release.yml`) and links github.com/OWASP repos including BLT-Bacon.

## What to do

1. Describe the actual features.
2. Document the `.forkmesh` release workflow and `scripts/deploy.sh blt-extension`.
3. Use `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/<Project>` links (BLT-Bacon becomes BLT-Rewards) and note that `install.sh` still pulls from the GitHub mirror.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No github.com/OWASP links
- [ ] Release steps match the workflow
- [ ] Feature claims match the code

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-extension
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
